tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: review_pr
tools.description:
Submit one review on an open pull request selected by exact pr_id.

        decision must be approve, request_changes, or comment. body may be omitted
        for approve. request_changes and comment require nonempty body text. The PR
        must already exist and be open. Returns the complete stored review record.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

Keep the copy strictly to source-time sequence of observed, provenance-backed state; do not imply causality, release readiness/safety, or employee performance. Please add/adjust regressions for audit-time permutations, equal-source-time tie-breaks, and missing/malformed required timestamps.

For equal valid source timestamps, use the established deterministic `authority_type` then `authority_record_id` tie-break, never a processing-time fallback. The `delayed_retry` fixture currently expects incident_load first because its `processed_at` is later, although its source timestamp (08:12) precedes the deploy event (08:47); change the expected visible order to deploy_event then incident_load and cover retry/delay cases accordingly. If any required `source_timestamp` is absent or malformed, render explicit unknown—not `{ chronology: [] }`—so the customer sees the required uncertainty rather than an empty/misleading chronology. Keep the copy strictly to source-time sequence of observed, provenance-backed state; do not imply causality, release readiness/safety, or employee performance. Please add/adjust regressions for audit-time permutations, equal-source-time tie-breaks, and missing/malformed required timestamps.
